headline: Expanding Opportunities Across Key Growth Segments

highlights: EBITDA margin expanded by ~250bps YoY to 12.6%, supported by operating leverage.
Management revised FY27 revenue growth guidance upward to ~30% from 26–30%, while retaining gross margin guidance of 33–35%.
The company has commenced semiconductor equipment manufacturing revenues and expects the vertical to contribute ~10% of topline over the coming quarters.
AVALON achieved its earlier target of doubling revenues from FY24 to FY27 nearly one year ahead of schedule and has set a target to further double revenues between FY26 and FY29.

AVALON achieved its earlier target of doubling revenues from FY24 to FY27 nearly one year ahead of schedule and has set a target to further double revenues between FY26 and FY29.
